_comment: Animation presets for omacraft.animations. Each animation is [speed, curve, style?] or false to disable the leaf. Speed is Hyprland's duration in deciseconds (lower = faster). Curves may name Omarchy's built-ins (default, easeOutQuint, easeInOutCubic, linear, almostLinear, quick) or any entry in `curves`. Add your own presets in ~/.config/omarchy/animation-presets.json using the same shape. `borders` are colour runs for the window border (`omarchy-animations border <id>`), hex without #.
